meta.methodology: OctaSpace prices are live averages of current marketplace asking prices, refreshed in your browser. Competitor prices are verified on the dates shown. 'From' prices are the cheapest offer found (Vast.ai = spot tier; SaladCloud = Lowest priority tier). Platform fees, storage, and egress are excluded from all columns.
